checks.name: westSmallGalleryHighEdge
checks.note: High edge is attached to the west ear; low edge drains toward the courtyard.

checks.name: eastSmallGalleryHighEdge
checks.note: High edge is attached to the east ear; low edge drains toward the courtyard.

checks.name: galleryCornerOverlap
checks.note: Side galleries stop at the big-gallery junction instead of extending through it.

checks.name: mainRoofTransverseSymmetry
checks.note: Both roof slopes meet at the ridge-purlin control point and return to equal eave elevations.

checks.name: elevationProjectionSeparation
checks.note: South exterior, east/west side and north courtyard elevations are expressed as separate projections.

checks.name: doubleDoorLeafWidth
checks.note: Each animated leaf uses exactly one half of its host opening width.

checks.name: gableWallToRidge
checks.note: Main-house and ear-house gable envelopes follow the wall-plane intersection with the roof underside, closing the former overhang wedge gap.

checks.name: mainGateSolidWallHead
checks.note: The central gate has continuous solid wall body above the two half-width door leaves.

checks.name: roundTimberColumns
checks.note: Gallery and frame columns use 12-sided round timber shafts; only the stone footings remain square.

checks.name: dailyUseDoglegStair
checks.note: The rejected straight 13-step interpretation was removed. Each stair now uses 8+8 risers, approximately 0.28 m goings, an intermediate landing, closed side stringers and continuous handrails.

checks.name: openGalleryTimberPartitions
checks.note: Courtyard galleries remain open in front of framed timber room partitions with lower panels and upper lattice fields.

checks.name: individualTaperedPanAndCoverTileRoof
checks.note: In-app WebGL roof-top and close-eave inspection confirms individual curved pan tiles below and individual curved cover tiles above every pan joint. Pan pieces taper from about 242 to 221 mm over about 223 mm; cover pieces taper from about 115 to 90 mm over about 222 mm. Every course has an explicit ceramic end lip. Longitudinal exposure remains a visual calibration from the user-supplied local roof photograph and is not claimed as a measured lap.

checks.name: roofEnvelopeNoColorLeak
checks.note: In-app WebGL exterior, roof-top and underside views confirm continuous mud-backed sheathing, 210 mm rafters and timber eave boards beneath the rebuilt single-tile fields, with no exposed wall color, missing roof patch or post piercing the roof.

checks.name: batteredEarthWalls
checks.note: Main and ear-house exterior earth walls taper inward from their stone bases; gable infill aligns with the tapered top plane and closes to the roof underside.

checks.name: concealedExteriorTimber
checks.note: Embedded frame posts on outer earth-wall planes are hidden in complete view and remain available for construction inspection when walls are switched off.

checks.name: firstPersonEntry
checks.note: Eye-height stations run from the exterior through the half-width gate leaves to the courtyard, dogleg stair and upper floor; mouse look, WASD and wheel movement are enabled.

checks.name: detailedDoorAndWallHead
checks.note: Gate leaves contain stiles, rails, lower panels and upper lattice. Each leaf is half the opening and a continuous wall body remains above the door.

checks.name: sideElevationOpenings
checks.note: Exact side-wall openings await finer measured drawings.

checks.name: interStoreyJoint
checks.note: Floor beams, joists, boards and upper-frame bearing order await detailed sections.
